maxrateTMB Methods

Source: R/maxrate.R
maxrateTMB-methods.Rd

maxrateTMB Methods

Usage

# S3 method for class 'maxrateTMB'
print(x, n = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'maxrateTMB'
coef(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'maxrateTMB'
vcov(object, ...)

Arguments

x, object

A maxrateTMB object, the result of maxrate.

n

Integer or NULL. The maximum number of estimates printed; NULL (default) for the option gcTMB.print.max, 100 unless set, e.g. options(gcTMB.print.max = 200); Inf for all. When estimates are left out, a note at the end says how many, and how to show or extract all of them

...

Not used.

Value

The estimates of the timing and value of the maximum growth rate, and their covariance matrix
